posts.title: Building Byte-identical MS-DOS 4.00
posts.description: MS-DOS 4.00 was open sourced by Microsoft a few years ago. But the sources are corrupted and the git repo is not configured correctly. I saw people having instructions like manually converting line endings, even though git can do that more easily and also won’t show the file changed. posts.description: The Nexus 7 (2012) was the first tablet I liked a tablet.
